Upbeat.description: High energy and cheerful. Loves clever, funny, and witty remarks. Dislikes indecisive or vague answers.

Timid.description: Easily frightened and cautious. Responds best to kindness, empathy, and gentleness. Never joke or tease them.

Gloomy.description: Melancholy and cynical. Prefers mysterious, casual, or vague replies. Dislikes overly sweet sympathy.

Irritable.description: Aggressive and impatient. Demands direct, serious, and no-nonsense responses. Hates soft, timid excuses.

sun_confidant_perks.name: Speechcraft
sun_confidant_perks.effect: Unlocks politician speeches for Charm stat boost on Sundays.

sun_confidant_perks.name: Diplomacy
sun_confidant_perks.effect: Occasionally enables demanding more money or rare items during hold-up negotiations.

sun_confidant_perks.name: Fundraising
sun_confidant_perks.effect: Enables repeatedly demanding money from downed Shadows during a single negotiation.

sun_confidant_perks.name: Manipulation
sun_confidant_perks.effect: Enemies will sometimes offer rare and high-value items during negotiations.

sun_confidant_perks.name: Mind Control
sun_confidant_perks.effect: Allows skipping negotiation entirely and recruiting downed Shadows with a single speech prompt.

sun_confidant_perks.name: Charismatic Speech
sun_confidant_perks.effect: Allows recruiting Shadows that are HIGHER level than Joker!

mechanics.title: 1. Red Aura / Disaster Shadows
mechanics.desc: Disaster Shadows (glowing red aura) cannot be negotiated with during hold-ups. Defeating them causes a chain explosion that damages other enemies!

mechanics.title: 2. Chariot Rank 7 (Insta-Kill)
mechanics.desc: Ryuji's Insta-Kill perk in Mementos/Palaces automatically defeats shadows 10+ levels below Joker and instantly recruits their Persona without any dialogue!

mechanics.title: 3. Already Owned Personas
mechanics.desc: If you negotiate with a Persona already in your stock, they skip conversation immediately and grant bonus EXP to that Persona.

major_arcana.name: 0. Fool
major_arcana.effect: Increases all EXP gained by +20% for the rest of Tartarus exploration.

major_arcana.name: I. Magician
major_arcana.effect: Levels up a random skill on your equipped Persona to its next tier.

major_arcana.name: II. Priestess
major_arcana.effect: Increases All-Out Attack damage dealt by all party members.

major_arcana.name: III. Empress
major_arcana.effect: Increases status ailment recovery and evasion rate.

major_arcana.name: IV. Emperor
major_arcana.effect: Grants permanent stat increases to your equipped Persona.

major_arcana.name: V. Hierophant
major_arcana.effect: Guarantees extra card pick opportunities in future Shuffle Times.

major_arcana.name: VI. Lovers
major_arcana.effect: Greatly increases item and treasure chest discovery rates.

major_arcana.name: VII. Chariot
major_arcana.effect: Permanently increases the Protagonist's Max HP by +10.

major_arcana.name: VIII. Justice
major_arcana.effect: Enables picking 1 additional card in every Shuffle Time.

major_arcana.name: IX. Hermit
major_arcana.effect: Permanently increases the Protagonist's Max SP by +5.

major_arcana.name: X. Fortune
major_arcana.effect: Increases Critical Hit rate for all party members.

major_arcana.name: XI. Strength
major_arcana.effect: Increases Physical damage dealt by the entire party.

major_arcana.name: XII. Hanged Man
major_arcana.effect: Increases defense and reduces physical damage taken.

major_arcana.name: XIII. Death
major_arcana.effect: Risk / Reward card: Increases spawn chance of rare shadows and Reaper.

major_arcana.name: XIV. Temperance
major_arcana.effect: Grants +50% EXP to benched / inactive party members.

major_arcana.name: XV. Devil
major_arcana.effect: Doubles all Yen / Money dropped from battles.

major_arcana.name: XVI. Tower
major_arcana.effect: Fills the Theurgy gauge for all active party members.

major_arcana.name: XVII. Star
major_arcana.effect: Increases Magic damage dealt by the entire party.

major_arcana.name: XVIII. Moon
major_arcana.effect: Fully restores HP and SP for all party members after battle.

major_arcana.name: XIX. Sun
major_arcana.effect: Removes the Protagonist level cap on Velvet Room fusions for today!

major_arcana.name: XX. Judgement
major_arcana.effect: Grants massive bonus EXP to the next fused Persona.

major_arcana.name: XXI. Aeon
major_arcana.effect: Triggers Arcana Burst, unlocking permanent extra picks in Shuffle Time!

minor_arcana.title: Skill Cards & Weapons
minor_arcana.desc: Grants physical, elemental, support skill cards or equipment upgrades.

minor_arcana.title: Recovery & Healing
minor_arcana.desc: Restores a percentage of HP and SP to all party members immediately.

minor_arcana.title: Bonus Money / Yen
minor_arcana.desc: Grants substantial amounts of bonus Yen scaled by dungeon floor rank.

minor_arcana.title: Bonus EXP Multiplier
minor_arcana.desc: Increases battle EXP reward by up to +100%.

mechanics.title: How to Trigger Shuffle Time
mechanics.desc: Shuffle Time is guaranteed when you finish a battle with an All-Out Attack, or when defeating the final enemy using the Protagonist's attack.

mechanics.title: Arcana Burst
mechanics.desc: Collecting the required quota of Major Arcana cards in a single Tartarus exploration triggers an Arcana Burst, permanently granting +1 additional card pick for every future Shuffle Time until leaving Tartarus.

mechanics.title: Monad Doors & Passages
mechanics.desc: Defeating Monad Shadows guarantees rare Major Arcana cards with potent exploration perks.

minor_arcana_details.description: Minor Arcana cards appear during Shuffle Time with ranks from 1 to 10, J, Q, and K. Higher rank cards appear in deeper dungeon floors and grant significantly better rewards, rare skill cards, and massive EXP multipliers.

sweep_guide.title: What is an All-Clear / Sweep Bonus?
sweep_guide.desc: If you choose every single card shown in Shuffle Time (using cards with +1 / +2 draw perks to clear penalty cards), you trigger an All-Clear Sweep Bonus!

sweep_guide.title: Sweep Bonus Rewards
sweep_guide.desc:
1. Guarantees a Shuffle Time after the very next battle.
2. Gives +3 starting card picks on the next Shuffle Time.
3. Converts all cards into higher ranks with positive effects!

sweep_guide.title: How to Achieve Sweeps Reliably
sweep_guide.desc: Always pick cards that grant extra draws (like Justice, Hierophant, or Devil) before picking penalty cards (like half money/no exp) so you can pick every card on screen.

major_arcana.name: Magician
major_arcana.effect: Levels up one random skill of the equipped Persona to its next tier.

major_arcana.name: Emperor
major_arcana.effect: Levels up the equipped Persona by 1 level.

major_arcana.name: Priestess
major_arcana.effect: Flips one face-down card face-up and grants +1 draw.

major_arcana.name: Hierophant
major_arcana.effect: Grants +1 additional card draw in the current Shuffle Time.

major_arcana.name: Lovers
major_arcana.effect: Allows picking 2 cards of your choice without penalty.

major_arcana.name: Chariot
major_arcana.effect: Grants +1 Agility or Endurance to equipped Persona.

major_arcana.name: Justice
major_arcana.effect: Grants +2 additional card draws in the current Shuffle Time.

major_arcana.name: Hermit
major_arcana.effect: Reveals dungeon map for the current floor.

major_arcana.name: Fortune
major_arcana.effect: Grants +1 Luck to equipped Persona.

major_arcana.name: Strength
major_arcana.effect: Grants +1 Strength to equipped Persona.

major_arcana.name: Hanged Man
major_arcana.effect: Decreases 1 stat on equipped Persona, but increases another by +2.

major_arcana.name: Death
major_arcana.effect: Opens a cursed chest — triggers the Reaper encounter if 21 chests were opened!

major_arcana.name: Temperance
major_arcana.effect: Grants bonus chests on the current dungeon floor.

major_arcana.name: Devil
major_arcana.effect: Grants +3 extra card draws, but forfeits Yen or EXP reward from this battle.

major_arcana.name: Tower
major_arcana.effect: Destroys all chest keys, but grants +3 card draws.

major_arcana.name: Star
major_arcana.effect: Grants +1 Magic to equipped Persona.

major_arcana.name: Moon
major_arcana.effect: Halves battle EXP, but grants +1 card draw.

major_arcana.name: Sun
major_arcana.effect: Grants +1 card draw and transforms a penalty card into a bonus card.

major_arcana.name: Judgement
major_arcana.effect: Replaces all remaining cards with random new cards.

major_arcana.name: Fool
major_arcana.effect: Changes all remaining cards into 1 single powerful card.

minor_arcana.title: Skill Cards
minor_arcana.desc: Grants skill cards of rank 1 to 10.

minor_arcana.title: HP & SP Recovery
minor_arcana.desc: Restores HP and SP to the entire party.

minor_arcana_details.description: Minor Arcana cards appear during Shuffle Time with ranks from 1 to 10 (or King). Higher rank cards appear in deeper dungeon floors and grant significantly better rewards, rare skill cards, and massive EXP multipliers.
